objective.en: Practice typing complete sentences with proper capitalization and punctuation at speed.

tips.en: Read slightly ahead of what you are typing to maintain flow.

items: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the quiet river bank.
Every morning she reads the paper, drinks her coffee, and plans the day ahead.

Walking through the forest at dawn, they noticed how the golden light filtered through the tall oak trees.
